purpose: One native thinking-only ablation on the first exposed v2 failure; no promotion or claim from a single development case.

candidate.native_renderer: same native gemma4 small renderer; boolean thinking enabled
candidate.candidate_model_template_or_adapter_chan: Only one line in a separate copy of the archived adapter: body[think]False becomes True. Original files remain immutable.

request_profile.schema: unchanged original production translation JSON schema
request_profile.source_messages: exact original full system and user messages; no hints, replacements, glossary or added answers

evaluation.criteria: original three case criteria plus unchanged global meaning/name/number/unit/relationship/negation/uncertainty/action/condition/chronology/completeness requirements
evaluation.independent_review: package_verification with source/criteria binding before any output inspection

limits.scope: Externally sampled concurrent supervisor, worker, owned daemon and native process tree; not kernel cap or whole-app approval.

before_execution: Root reviews this concrete source-supported proposal; no inference is authorized merely by writing it.

Freeze separate candidate copy, worker and supervisor hashes, exact archived helper/evaluator dependencies and independent original source/criteria binding. Do not edit prior frozen scripts or source hash records.

Verify the same full model payload, imported descriptors/config/params, runtime binaries and native renderer/parser identity. Record current checkout identity separately; execute the archived snapshot, not changed production code.
Preflight the actual complete native thinking prompt and loaded-tokenizer count before the single generation. Require prompt+2048+1<=4096 with no cropping, context/output change or model alternate.
during_and_after: Assert the one actual generation request equals the retained non-thinking request except think:true, including source text and schema. Preserve every original segment metadata field.

Record the separate reasoning field and full raw final response. Do not grade reasoning as the translation. A missing separated reasoning span must be reported explicitly rather than assumed to demonstrate deliberation.

Accept execution only on normal stop, nonempty final content, valid original schema/count, actual prompt count equal to preflight and generated count below2048. Reject any length, timeout, resource, parse, measurement or cleanup failure and retain all evidence.
Explicitly unload, verify the resident-model list is empty and stop the owned process group. No retries or repair.

Independent semantic judgment determines whether the original telescope criteria improve. Failure stops this ablation; a passing first case still does not approve remaining v2, fresh v3, summaries, whole-app resources or production adoption.
